title: Poor online experience
review: Like other reviewers, I would agree that the in store experience is very good, however ordering online is a whole different story. I placed a click and collect order for a soundbar a week ago, and the website lead me to believe it would be shipped the next day.After a couple of days I called customer service, to be told that it would be in store on Friday, a week after I placed the order. I appreciate that Christmas fell in between, so I was willing to give them the benefit of the doubt. Needless to say the soundbar didn’t ship, so a week later I called to cancel the order, only to be told there’s a stock issue, and that the cancellation had to be processed by the store, even though the order was placed online. Had the website told me the item was out of stock I wouldn’t have placed the order, but presumably Richer Sounds are only interested in taking your money.Customer service weren’t particularly helpful, so I’m waiting to hear back from the store about the cancellation. Be wary of ordering online from this company. Update - it turns out the item was shipped (despite the website saying it hadn’t) so I was able to pick it up at the store. The store were excellent in sorting everything out so I’ve amended my rating. I still maintain that the online ordering process leaves a lot to be desired.

title: New straighteners, FOC gift did not apply :-(
review: I needed new straighteners, so I looked at GHD, Cloud Nine, Dyson....the usual suspects, but thought I would opt for GHD's as they offered a free gift with the purchase. It would be nice to try a new product.All the items were all pretty much the same price otherwise.My straighteners arrived, but no free gift?!?!Assuming this was just an oversight, I dropped GHD a message asking for an update on the dispatch of my free gift.Response - apparently, I did not qualify for this gift - even though it was placed in my basket by GHD, due to signing up as a new customer. As GHD had given  a discount on the item - the gift did not apply. However, both were showing in my basket at checkout. I feel a little duped. I ordered the product on my smartphone and did not see any terms regarding this, but GHD said there was in a 'banner' at the top of my '2 inch screen'. GHD - DO BETTER!!!If an item is being offered as a free gift and does not apply - make sure the customer is aware of this. Take the item out of their basket before they purchase the product.  Let the customer have choice and do not dupe them.Its underhand and unproffesional.

title: Issues in 12months of ownership.
review: I purchased the GHD Platinum+ straighteners back in June 2022. I was torn between these and the T3 hair straighteners. In the beginning these straighteners were brilliant. My hair didn't feel too hot to touch and still smelt like the hair products I had used not that burnt hair straightener smell and hair was sleek, soft and shiny.12 months of ownership I have noticed that there is a strong burning smell coming from them once they have reached temperature. They leave a burnt smell on my hair which they never used too. In addition, there has been a lot of steam coming from them both when placed on my hair and when they aren't.Whilst they still straighten my hair well, it smells burnt, I have visible signs of heat damage and I have experienced more breakage and my hair is also more dry.I have switched hair products I'm case that wasn't helping. It's made no difference. I have cleaned the plates and that's made no difference. I wish I had purchased the T3 straighteners now. I did register the warranty and have reported this to GHD but I can't see them doing anything about it. I will post updated reviews once I hear back from GHD.

description:
Vax was founded in 1977 by British entrepreneur, Alan Brazier, in his home town of Droitwich, Worcestershire. The brand shot to fame with the launch of the iconic orange tub carpet cleaner, and since then Vax has become a market leader in floorcare products. Still based in Droitwich, the Vax team have developed and innovated a range of products to now include vacuum cleaners, carpet washers, steamers, hard floor cleaners and solutions.

The success of Vax has been driven by the belief of listening to customers and keeping the end consumer in mind. As experts in floorcare for over forty years, Vax has never stopped striving to make cleaning quicker, easier and more effortless.

title: Thanks for the memory...!
review: Well, I finally gathered the courage to install my new Kingston Fury Impact DDR5 16Gb x2 into my Gigabyte Aorus 16X 9SG. I bought a tool kit with a Torx 6 security drive (Jorest - dark metal bits - Amazon), opened the laptop case (using the case-splitter tool (that came with the tool kit) and replaced the memory (careful of the two strips of what look like soft blutac between the sticks) - the process made easy courtesy of MrMemory, who's website is full of vital information to help the tech-wary customer. Even before I bought the memory, using the scanning tool, I was a bit lost as the results were for the 16X ASG model. A couple of rapidly answered emails to MrMemory and it was clear that my laptop shared the same results. I chose the Kingston, from the choices available - all being fully described, as it showed lower 'latency' than the Corsair - hey, it's a learning curve! My laptop is playing games with ease, and all thanks the brilliant service, from scan-to-install, via MrMemory. No regrets from me! I now have my heart set on another 1Tb of SSD......

review: I bought 3 items (including SSD), which were delivered quickly and safely by Mr. Memory!  Thank you very much!However, the reason why I did not award 5 Stars (but only 4) is because the supporting software in respect of the "cloning and installation of SSD" did not work because it was (copyright) protected and required "the authorisation code" which Mr. Memory did not provide.  Hence, we had to spend hours to seek and try various software programs on Internet to find the one which will work with the items purchased at Mr. Memory.Overall, I give positive rating!

title: Good prducts, shame about the lack of service
review: I have bought RAM from this company a number of times, the last time I purchased one of the DIMMs was faulty and had to be returned. The returns process wasn't the most friendly I have had and the staff I spoke to were abrasive and arrogant.So this time when I ordered I sent a query from their Contact Us webpage asking for the RAM to be tested before dispatch. This webpage boasts "Response times are very fast, if not instant during office hours". The query was sent during office hours. A day later no response had arrived so I called them and asked why they had not responded (particularly bearing in mind the boast above!). The person I spoke to really couldn't have cared less and refused to engage with me, so I asked for a manager callback. It is now 3 days since that request and no callback has materialised....so be warned, if you have an issue, they are not interested, and certainly don't bother calling them as whoever is on the phones needs to learn some respect for customers!

The RAM was returned then I recieved an email claiming that I owed them money for an order which I had not placed. For now, they’ve lost my trust.

title: Unreliable Hotpoint washing machine
review: two days ago I left a review on Appliance Online's website where I purchased a Hotpoint Washing mc .. on reflection I should have directed it to Hotpoint ..Here is a cut and paste  of that review..'Unreliable Hotpoint washing machine'AO have been my 'go to' online shop for several years and have always been very helpful..today tarnished this sentiment unfortunately when I called Hotpoint re a washing machine 'Hotpoint Invertermotor NSWA43CWWUK' I bought 28.04.20 from AO... it worked perfectly for 18 months or so then started to vibrate 'on spin' which steadily got worse despite all my efforts adjusting the legs , laying rubber padding underneath to dampen the vibration and then adding newspaper packing at the sides to try and improve this annoying malfunction...to no avail.. in fact the carcass has now split at the top right hand corner and the detergent dispenser rattles during use!My call to Hotpoint was prompted by a letter I received yesterday from Smartcare offering to cover my washing machine for repairs etc.. it had incorrect information stating my machine was over 3 years old..! but I phoned Hotpoint anyway to get a price.. I had actually become accustomed to the racket and the machine had come with a free 10 year parts guarantee !!I eventually managed to talk to a Hotpoint engineer after going through auto phone , then receptionist , then another wait 11th in queue to engineer.. the recommendation was to get through online but route was thwarted when no response after two attempts..long story but the gist is the engineer did not have a record of my machine although he said i'd had a repair done before .. news to me!! and the receptionist had found my account.. but it seemed the 10 year free parts amounted to nothing when he went on to offer 2 options1 - £137 for engineer to fix the fault .. vat was not mentioned before he said there would be a £70 callout charge if the engineer could not fix the fault2 - 12 payments of £22.09 (£265.08) to fix the fault .. one or both guaranteed for 30 wks !bottom line.. I was not impressed when the engineer suggested it sounded like a bearing wearing out.. I was hoping it was more a case of the balance and could possibly be fixed like a tyre and by adjusting the internal ballast... but then I don't know..!..but I ended the conversation by saying I wouldn't be buying a Hotpoint again.. (for a while anyway!) unreliable by my last experience!!Date of experience: 22 March 2023

title: Poor after sales support - Update Dec 30th
review: We had a Beko integrated Fridge Freezer supplied and fitted December 12th. Once we were able to operate it it began freezing up at the back of the fridge due to the unit being misaligned with the front of the carcase case causing an issue with it achieving a good and reliable seal. I contacted the company by email and received notification that my enquiry was being looked into but no further contact occurred. I got through to customer support on my second attempt after over an hour of waiting and explained the problem. I was told that they would arrange a date with the fitting manager to return to resolve the issue and would ring me back. So far nothing.  I have phoned customer service two more times and have waited until I was first in the queue on both occasions only to then have the line automatically disconnect. I still await resolution to this problem. If I had not had this issue then I would have no complaints, but a company is only as good as it's ability to resolve issues when they arise. I will try contacting them again after Xmas. I understand that this time of year is busy but that is no excuse for such poor communications.Update Dec 30th: On Dec 28th I tried again to contact customer support, this time successfully. It appears that they are aware of issues with their phone system which are now hopefully resolved  and which were the result of an update to their system. In my case my problem was compounded by the support person who answered my first call having then been on holiday for a week with no one else picking up on my call in the interim period. On my recent call I spoke again with the original call handler who was able to rapidly arrange for a visit by an installer with minimum delay. I can now report that the installers have re-installed the unit and the issue appears to be resolved.Assuming no further issues and that they have resolved their call handling problems then I would not hesitate to recommend them and I would consider using them in the future.

title: First time using Marks....
review: Edit - tumble dryer did in fact arrive at 6:10. Well done to the delivery team, they must have been under extreme pressure as they were running 3hours late. Shame I didn't get a call but I understand how things can get sometime. Mixed feelings of the whole experience. I'll update with a long term review. Hopefully the tumble dryer won't need any attention. What can I say, everyone seems to have good things to say about this company... About ab and baz or whatever (if you've read some of the other trustpilot reviews thinking is it just me that got poor service... You're not alone) I'm a simple guy, I ordered a product on Black Friday and appreciate it's not going to be in stock, particularly as I got a great price on it. But the problem occurs when you try and get some information from this company, you're stuck in a queue (more often than not 30 deep) then when you finally get through an hour later - you're met with someone called Sriraj. I asked if I could have an update regarding the order. Now colour me sceptical, but considering it was out of stock "on order from the supplier and awaiting stock to arrive to them" for 2 weeks and I magically called on the day the tumble dryer came into their warehouse, I can be forgiven for thinking I'm only getting the appliance sent to me and order progressed because I called up. So anyway, Sriraj exclaimed it's just come into stock! When would you like to have it delivered. I asked if he could hold on the phone so I could discuss and arrange with the other half for the best time/date etc. He said "just tell me when you want it delivered" I mean maybe this is new age customer service hey? Anyways dates set! I was sceptical due to the average customer service I had but I've had the email confirming it! (you might be able to see where this is going) I've cleared the space for the tumble dryer to roll it's way in, the 2 hour slot was confirmed the night before for 2-4pm....here we go right? Well no.... 12 o clock came ...im at home, 1pm I'm still here..... 2 pm ok I can't wait..... 3pm.... The actual time they said they'd likely be here... (no, no call, if you're thinking maybe they kept me in the loop)......3:45.... They're going to make it like Indiana Jones, right under the closing door...... 4pm.... 4:40....now I'm in the queue I was talking about earlier (remember that one... 30 deep)......Well boys and girls thanks for sticking with me through this.... If you got this far, you're probably expecting for Mark's to say (like me) they attempted to deliver, but no one was home.The funniest bit in all this is they send you an email threatening if you're not at home when the appliance is delivered you'll be charged £50 for each appliance for missing the delivery. I wonder if they'll compensate me my day rate for having to take the day off work to be home.Yours sincerely,Dee

title: I’m writing this as 2 star
review: I’m writing this as 2 star, purely due to the fact I have had such hassle trying to return a broken cooker. First cooker I received was broken only discovered on installation. I called customer service on the Saturday and sat in a 2hour cue! Got a lovely lady who informed me that the maker of the appliance had to provide an uplift number to marks electrical before they could accept it as a return and arrange collection. I accepted this as I was given the impression that it wouldn’t be too long. In the meantime I ordered a different make of cooker, from marks electrical and arranged for delivery on the Wednesday. Having heard nothing about the return by Tuesday I rang customer service, sat in yet another 2 hour cue! Got a lovely lady who advised she was still awaiting the uplift number. She required video evidence of the faults, which I emailed. So Wednesday I had 3 cookers in my house, my old one the broken one and the new one!I emailed saying I had the opportunity to return the faulty cooker to them on the Saturday, no response. So Saturday myself and my partner returned the cooker to be told we could not leave it there by a less than helpful salesman on the desk. He accused us of fly tipping ! Two lovely young people came to our assistance and with a chat about the situation they allowed us to leave the cooker there until the matter was resolved. The following Tuesday I had a call from a repair company wanting to come out to repair the faulty cooker!I informed them I had returned the appliance to marks electrical. They spoke to the regional office and arrange for an uplift number to be sent. Having heard nothing from Marks Electrical about a refund,I opened a PayPal dispute to resolve the issue.Within a few days I received a refund. I would not recommend using Marks electrical due to the very difficult returns process, you would not get this treatment from another provider. I would definitely suggest a career change for the gentleman ‘Mr E’ on the sales desk. The lovely young people who actually helped us deserve praise for their kindness and understanding.

description:
MY MULTIBUY
SHOP FRIDGE FREEZERS
SHOP RANGE COOKERS
SHOP DISHWASHERS
We’re Unique
Our Multibuy tool is perfect for if you’re looking for a selection of appliances. Although we monitor prices daily, we’re happy to discuss an extra discount if you’re buying multiple appliances. This makes us considerably cheaper than a lot of our competitors. Simply add your appliances to our Multibuy tool and send off your request, or just give us a call and we’ll give you an instant quote!

We Care About Customers
We strive to get it right 100% of the time, but on the odd occasion that there is an issue with your order, we want you to know that there’s a dedicated team on hand to help. No call centres, no endless queues. Just genuine hard-working people. Monday to Friday, 9am until 17:30pm, and until 4pm on Saturdays, we’re here to receive your calls and messages. 

We Love Our Showroom
We understand buying online isn’t always easy. That’s why we have a showroom filled with our favourite appliances ready for you to come and see. Not only can you see our shiny appliances on display, you can also ask for advice from our appliance experts. And if you’re happy with your choice, you can even buy and take your appliance there and then. 

Please make sure to give us a call first to make sure that the model or appliance you want to look at is out on display. 

We Know Appliances
Creating your perfect kitchen can be tough. There are so many brands, types and features to choose from, it can all be very overwhelming. That’s why we have a friendly team of experts here to help you every step of the way! They’ve been working with appliances for decades; whether its fittings, colours, prices or delivery, there’s not a question they can’t, and don’t, want to answer. 

We Price Match
The appliance market is surprisingly competitive. But when it comes down to it, all we want is to give you the best service at the best price. So if you do manage to find your model in stock, ready for delivery, and at a cheaper price elsewhere, we’ll do our best to price match it. Just give us a call and we’ll see what we can do!

We’re First Class
We offer free, yes FREE, standard delivery to most UK postcodes, unlike many other UK appliance retailers. And there are many other options for you to choose from at checkout, such as delay my delivery and recycling. But no matter when or what you decide, our delivery team are always punctual, courteous and happy to help.  

We’re Thinking Green
We love appliances, but we know the damage they can cause to the environment. That’s why we have a fantastic recycling service: if you’d like, when we deliver your new appliance, we can take your old one away. We’re also strong believers and promoters of long-lasting, reliable appliances. No more of this cheap, buy-it and throw-it culture!
title: Great service throughout
review: Great service throughout. Our appliance was on back order and the sales team proactively kept us up to date with delivery expectations as they firmed up. Once a date was confirmed they stuck to it and shipped right on time. Delivery guys Shaun and Dave made a fab job of getting a large fridge/freezer through tight doorways with a minimum of fuss and were swift, polite and cheery. Overall - first class!

title: My washing machine was fitted by an unqualified person
review: My washing machine was fitted by the employee of Appliance City who arrived on his own and clearly had not been trained to do the job. He was not aware that the machines came fitted with transit bolts, and was going to plumb in the machine without removing them. He only removed them because by chance we had a Neff engineer in the kitchen mending another appliance and he spotted the mistake. The machine was fitted correctly only because it was done under the supervision of the Neff engineer. We paid for the machine to be plumbed in by a qualified person. It's only right that Appliance City should repay this cost. 17/12/24 I was contacted by a manager this morning. He was not defensive but listened carefully to what I had to say and agreed that this should not have happened and explained some of the circumstances. He has also refunded my installation fee. This is good old fashioned customer service which is all too rare these days. This level of customer care that I experienced means that I will definitely use this company again.

title: Poor delivery communication gap

They provide vague delivery timelines, such as "anytime during the day," which is not practical. It would be much better if they gave customers a 2–3-hour delivery time slot the day before, rather than leaving it uncertain.In my case, the delivery driver arrived early at 7 a.m., but my phone’s Do Not Disturb mode was active until 7:30 a.m., so I missed their call. When I called back around 7:45, I was told they couldn’t return, leaving me with no choice but to pay extra for redelivery. This extra cost undermines their competitive pricing and makes the experience frustrating.

When I looked at Arrow XL's facebook page I found similar things had happened to others.Now waiting for a delivery on 19th December, nine days late!This has now been delivered and is working fine. The customer service team have been in touch and are following up the complaint with the delivery comnany. I have supplied screenshots and email to assist them.

title: Disorganised delivery process
review: The website was very easy to use and I could find the appliances I needed. A week after placing the order (in November) I received an email saying that one item was waiting delivery from the manufacturer and this would be in mid December.  On the 11th of December I got an email saying goods were ready for dispatch and I should contact them to arrange a convenient date.   I emailed back to say I was available on Monday or Tuesday this week, but was told delivery was only available on Wednesday.   I’d planned get  the old appliances ready for uplift on Tuesday, and so was surprised to get a phone call from the delivery company saying they would deliver on Tuesday at Lunchtime, which they did.So this 3* review is entirely due to the rather chaotic and poorly organised post sales/delivery experience.   If you don’t have the ability to drop everything and wait for a delivery think carefully about ordering!

title: Ordering good, Fridge good, Courier less so
review: We needed a fridge of an unusual height, and Appliance City had one. Ordered by phone, efficient and pleasant, followed by email to confirm. All good so far.AC's email said I would receive a text from the designated courier React Transport with a 2 hr timeslot the day before delivery. What I actually got was a text asking whether I wanted the delivery to go ahead, with Yes/No boxes. I missed that, and by the time i saw it it just said No. I phoned the React number, got passed from Manchester to Reading, and I asked why I hadn't had the two hr slot as promised. I was told that it was not possible to do that, as each van had 20 deliveries. I was given, slightly unwillingly, a time estimate.The delivery was in the slot given, and the driver could not have been more helpful and pleasant - but he was on his own. We have 4 steps up from parking to front door, which I had mentioned, but that information hadn't got to the driver. He manhandled the fridge, with my help, and all was well in the end - but would have been difficult for customers who couldn't help. It's not good for the deliverers backs either - and his next delivery was a washing machine - and these are heavier than fridges.Overall Appliance City were fine, and had what I wanted. However, I'd be wary about ordering anything else, because of the poor communications and single driver that React Transport used.

title: Delivery experience wasn't great.
review: The price and product (a large fridge freezer) were fantastic. Ordering process was pretty good too and they did deliver on the day promised. The delivery experience however wasn't good, so much so, I doubt I would order from them again. The driver wasn't happy delivering in London as when he called he explained he couldn't use double yellow lines to deliver the appliance.  I suggested a delivery bay but he had to have sight of his van at all times and that wasn't suitable.  I had no idea of the prerequisites I noticed a bay for shops and he drove past it a few times reluctant to use it but thankfully did. It had a 30 min parking limit and he was worried this wasn't enough.  I really don't know why this was my problem. I live in London, other companies can do this. My feeling was the driver was very keen not to deliver the goods.The next confusion was the web site.  There was an additional £50 charge to have the product delivered to another floor. They used a picture of a house with a chimney to depict this and I thought ... I live in a 1st floor flat with a lift and it wouldn't apply.  The driver thought I should have paid it which I was happy to do as I never understood the requirement in the order process.  The significance of not paying the extra was they only sent one delivery guy with a trolley to move a very large appliance.  This became an issue when the applicance barely fitted in the lift.  The guy did try through.  We knew it would fit if the packaging was removed but he said he couldn't do that.  We offered to take full responsibility for any damage but he refused to help us. We explained using his trolley would make it easy but again he couldn't help.  We desperately needed the appliance so we accepted this 80kg 2m appliance would be left in our foyer.  It was a nightmare moving it into the lift without a trolley but it fitted in just fine thankfully in the end. So an awful delivey experience caused by reluctance to park in London and a confusing order process which meant only one driver was sent.  I wish the implications were made clearer on ordering.

No - its terrible!1. The smart TRV’s are absolutely terrible! They detect vastly incorrect temperatures. They over run, they dont come on when needed… they dont respond…  impossible to adjust or calibrate them (other then the initial setup). 2. ZERO custumer service! NONE!! They tell you yo go to some stupid forum and post your question only to be forgotten and buried in the thousands of other questions. I have posted several questions and got zero responses. Once I looked I realised that most questions remain unanswered forever. How can they het away with this?!I could go on… but I will leave it here. In short I will never ever recommend Hive to anyone and as soon as I find a decent alternative I will chick the whole thing in the bin.

Basically it's rubbish. I've invested so much money I put up with it. I've got Neo on all the underfloor systems and that's far superior but they don't do radiator valves so I'm looking at zoning areas as an alternative

title: Expensive but they can find those old original parts
review: I have a Cannon BHC 120 cooker hood which is probably 20 years old. The lights haven’t worked for maybe ten of those years. I looked at buying a new one and they don’t exist anymore, but the cheapest alternative would be £890 +. So I called in NAC Domestic Appliances who attended on time and diagnosed a faulty transformer and printed circuit board. They tried to find one but unsurprisingly they’re out of production. £96 for the visit. They said if I could find the parts they would come back and fit them for free. The engineer said it was a really high quality hood and you can’t get them anymore. So I searched the internet (and rang my brother - an engineer), who suggested the PCB could be repaired. Back to the internet and I found the transformer available on Ransom Spares (aptly named - they charged £98 but then it is an original). The real find was Electronic Partners. They promised they can repair PCB’s. I don’t know if they’re a clearance house for various electricians but heyho. They sent me a postage label and asked the details. Off it went, then they asked me for the control panel as well (for testing) and then diagnosed the problem and estimated £108. I got it back a week later. They’d replaced the triacs apparently. NAC re attended today and pieced it back together (as they said - for free). It now works as if it were new. Just need to give it a polish now!

title: Why can you buy the same items online at half the price
review: Visited Currys today and the sales ladies  couldn't  have been more helpful. However they didn't have the product  we wanted in store. We were advised we could have  the product on display. I would have given lesser stars for the managers poor manner but the ladies deserved 4 stars.

We then had the cashier, who again was helpful but was on the phone to his supervisor or manager, saying that they need to get someone to tills as he has to go, his dad and brother were there to pick him up to go to the cinema. I think that could have been dealt with, without us and the rest of the queue hearing about it, however the chap was helpful and done the best he could.

review: Although delivered swiftly, I paid for installation and removal of the old appliance. They stated that they couldn't install the new one, due to the way the cupboard door was(?), and they couldn't remove the old one because it would leave loose pipes. I now have a new dishwasher still in its box, the old one still in situ, and I am still yet to receive a refund for the extra services. It's just disappointing that an alternative solution hasn't been provided. Would have expected more from Curry's.

title: Poor initial experience but resolution i am happy with reached
review: This company is an absolute scam.  Just got a new phone and not desperate to get rid of the old one but having read some good reviews on Trustpilot i thought i would give Phonebox a go.  Went online and got an offer of £353 for an iphone 13 Pro so thought given it was a decent offer i was happy with it was worth doing rather than having the phone sat in a drawer.They received my phone today and within a couple of hours i received an email telling me there was an issue.  No explanation provided but that they had revised my offer to £200.  That email was quickly followed by a second email again telling me there was a problem and my offer was now revised to £180!The reasons provided were:- Rear microphone quality issue – report available upon request- Visible scratching around the housing – Images available upon request.Safe to say i immediately rejected their revised offer and requested someone contact me to arrange the return of my phone to me, given i know for a fact the phone was in great condition and i also had zero issues with the microphone.I ended up receiving a call from a manager (the only good part of this experience was that the lady was very friendly and polite).I advised i was disgusted with the emails i had received and their revised offer and that i had had the phone in a solid phone case, with a screen protector, since new and i had also taken photos as proof of it’s condition before sending. The lady quickly went away to review my order. Upon her return, the lady advised me that actually there had been an error and my phone was in “pretty pristine condition” (her words) and that she would make me a revised offer of £270. She maintained that their Apple accredited software had advised there was an issue with the rear microphone so that needed to be replaced and apparently they would have to give the phone a polish to brighten up some dulling. Again i quickly declined the offer and asked for her to arrange the return of my phone, to which she seemed quite shocked that i wanted the phone back! She went away again and then came back with a second revised offer of £310, with the £43 deduction now being for the cost of a replacement microphone only.So in summary, i was originally offered £353, that was knocked down to £180 apparently due to an issue with the microphone (cost if which to replace is £43) and some “scratches”.  All of a sudden after i request my phone is returned and maintain my position, the “scratches” seem to disappear and they can suddenly offer me another £130 on top of their original revised offer.This company is quite clearly trying to rip people off by making up “issues” with devices and then low balling revised offers.When challenged on this, all of a sudden you are then advised that oh actually there was an error and your phone is in “pretty pristine” condition and you are suddenly offered much more than they try to get away with initially.I do not believe for a second that there was an “error” with my order, i simply believe that this company tries to get away with what they can in terms of reducing offers and paying people much less than they believe they will be receiving and then when challenged they fall back on the “error” excuse.I was in a position where i was not by any means desperate to sell the phone and to be quite honest i would have preferred to have given it away than accept an offer i felt was utter robbery by an unscrupulous company but i do fear for those who do need the funds more than i do and who are then getting ripped off by this company!Absolute disgrace and a horrible experience.NEVER AGAIN!!!!!!!!**UPDATE to original review 06/12/24** - Following my earlier experience, i received a further phone call from Nicola the next morning and was advised that she was extremely sorry i had had a bad experience and would like to try to reach a solution that we were both happy with.I was offered compensation which has now put me in a better position than i would have been.Whilst the original experience was not good, the company has since tried to make up for the experience & my dissatisfaction (they reached out to me in order to discuss and try to ensure i was leaving the experience more satisfied and not unhappy).  We have reached a resolution which i am now very happy with & Nicola was very pleasant to deal with throughout.

title: Shocking experience - avoid
review: I can only speak about my personal experience, but I had a shocking experience for my pristine iPhone 13 with Phone Box. Honestly don’t waste your time and just avoid them. Chose them because I saw good reviews online but should have known better (given it was just 700 reviews). Rejected their low ball offer and when I eventually got my phone back from them I tried somewhere actually trusty (WeBuyTek, who I’ve used before successfully) who paid me the full £230 quoted. With PhoneBox, I went via compare and recycle comparison website and was quoted £286 for ‘good’ condition (it was one of the highest offers so naturally I thought this would be great just before Christmas). PhoneBox told me it didn’t pass testing (something wrong with the microphone?!) and offered £166 instead! That’s quite a big difference! I rejected their counteroffer straight away but it then puts you through to get a call from some salesperson with an attitude who tries to negotiate a deal with you. I just wanted my phone back (asking about twenty times) but instead I had to deal with this outrageously awful ‘customer experience lead’ who tried awful tactics to try and get me to accept a lower offer when I just wanted my phone back. It was a really upsetting experience. They practically hold your phone hostage until you pay a £10 fee to get it back. Now, my real issue with the £10 fee is that being offered £120 less than quoted is a huuuuge difference, it felt like a scam and that I was mislead into sending them my phone in the first place. After a lot of chat they agreed to waive the £10 fee after I said I would post about my experience online which they were obviously worried about (the lady even said ‘sounds like you’re trying to extort us there’!). They said they would not charge the fee if I ‘left them in good faith’, in other words don’t post about us online - no chance - ordinary people deserve to know the truth. Honestly it’s such a tactic some of these companies use to high ball you to lure you in to a high price which they never deliver on. Feels like a scam. Just feels like the business model relies on people who just need money asap and who don’t know better or can’t be bothered shopping around. How come the place I actually sold my iPhone 13 to found no problems with the phone (or its microphone) and delivered on the price quoted? Phone Box said they would stop using the compare and recycle comparison website because really they can’t deliver the prices quoted - but how is that my problem? Do your own research but I would avoid these cowboys if I were you. You just can’t get away with treating people like that.

title: Misleading delivery information
review: Am disappointed with the misleading delivery information.  The order stated that if placed before 4pm it would be delivered the next day.  This was a Saturday but Drone Safe advised me that Saturday delivery was an extra charge however no where was this mentioned.  Apparently the order would have also stated that the delivery day was stated as Tuesday as it was a Bank Holiday,  if it was then I missed it.   Referencing the above the order confirmation could have clarified the position but it did not instead it stated the following :-'Drone Safe Zoom Delivery Service is connected by DPD delivering our customer parcels 6 days per week. They will contact you via email with a delivery time slot shortly.You can expect our Zoom Delivery Service next working day if ordered by 4 pm.'Note '6 days a week' and 'next working day if ordered by 4pm'  No mention of an extra charge !In all fairness the chat agent did agree with me when I mentioned that I thought the information was ambiguous and he did say that my issues and the errors would be fed back.  Had it not been for the fact I had taken a day off work to receive the delivery or had to re-arrange things for Tuesday then obviously my review would have been 5* Ok it's not the end of the world, inconvenient 'yes'. One thing I do find very frustrating though is being told one thing and it then confirmed in writing only to then be told something totally different which contradicts the communications received.Finally the invitation to leave this review arrived this evening (29/5) but adding to my frustration over the delivery the opening line of the review request said 'We hope you enjoyed your order, would you be kind enough to help us grow our business?'  ..... I haven't received the order and considering you advised me of the dates I would have thought you would have known.It's not difficult to only send automatic responses when certain criteria are met within either the web site or the integrated mailing system.  Being clear initially with the ordering process, its relevant advisories and ensuring the information is correct goes along way to ensure customer satisfaction.

title: T**d in the punchbowl
review: Clearly not a common issue but still needs to be addressed. Purchased a refurbished 2017 MacBook Pro in July 2023. Just enough time to convince you that you have a long lasting fully functioning MacBook. Its just over 6 months and my Mac now turns off with 80% battery life and won't come back on without being charged so excellent for being on the move and doing a job away from mains or places to charge. I politely emailed them and was told they will replace the battery for half the price they would normally charge so straight away this indicated there was a sense of guilt as opposed to goodwill and an understanding that they have sold me a faulty product. I declined and thanked them for selling me a faulty MacBook. Clearly these guys are running a good reputable business with the odd customer being ripped off but I was unfortunately one of those people and you could be too so why spend hundreds of pounds when its still a risk you could end up with a dodgy MacBook like me? I'll leave that with you.

title: Been buying Juicebitz stuff for years…
review: Been buying Juicebitz stuff for years and never had a problem with any of it - always much more reasonably priced than other big names (Anker, Ravpower etc). Knocked off a star this time because I bought the new power bank with PD as an upgrade to my previous Juicebitz one that didn't support PD. Disappointed to find that it came with a USB-A cable so I couldn't use the PD output until I'd bought a USB-C to USB-C cable. Bit tight, give us the cable that enables us to use the product's best feature - everybody already has a million USB-A - USB-C or old style USB cables.The powerbank is great though I couldn't get the wireless charging working and neither could my mate at work. The position is really critical and a slight movement and it goes off, but no matter, I don't want it for that.Other reason it loses a star is because the previous model also had a torch on it which was great in a tent in the middle of the night - and this one doesn't. Finally, it should have been bigger. The device is tiny and could easily have been 50% bigger for 15,000mah instead of 10,000. None of this is a reason not to buy it though and anything I have ordered over the years from Juicebitz has been good quality and arrived on time..

title: False cable specs
review: Ordered the premium usb Mini B cable : juicebitz /collections/mini-b/products/usb-type-a-male-to-mini-b-cable-premium-seriesWebsite said it was 22awg but when cable arrived the sheath had 24awg printed in it. I contacted juicebitz who advised that the cable is indeed 24awg and it was a copy and paste job from the specs of the core series cable which has 22awg wires. Was advised that the thicker 22awg wire wont fit in the premium moldings. So the so called premium cable is inferior to the cheaper core series cable.Now this makes me wonder about the premium micro usb braided cable i also ordered from them which is supposed to be 20awg but may indeed be 24awg too but the braiding hides the printing on the cable itself.Iv reached out to juicebitz for further clarification and confirmation of this.So far juicebitz has said they can send out a returns envelope for me to send the cable back, which is fine but im going to wait for them to get back to me regarding the micro usb cable. If they are unable to answer the question or i suspect foul play im gonna have to cut the cable open and inspect it carefully but will do this on video on my YouTube channel so there is no complaints that i have provided false information. I do suspect something is off with the braided micro usb cable since it does seem thinner than the core series micro usb cable that i have.UPDATE:Thanks for the reply. I will look into the return once you give me an update via email about the wire gauge on the braided micro usb cable. Is it actually 20awg or is it 24awg too? If its 24awg then it will have to go back too. Are the core series cables using copper wires or are they copper coated aluminium?UPDATE 2:I have measured the thickness of a core series micro usb cable using micrometer and as per your website it does show to be 4.0mm thick.I then measured the thickness of the premium braided micro usb cable and that came to 3.94mm thick. I have taken photos of these measurements and will email them to you. The braided cable doesnt seem to match up to the 4.2mm thickness your website lists them at so as suspected the cable may be 22awg or 24awg and possibly not 20awg as listed on your website.Hopefully you can verify this yourselves by measuring and removing the braiding on a cable and checking whats printed on it.UPDATE 3:I have emailed you the photos. Why is the Braided micro usb cable thinner than the non braided micro usb cable? The braid should have made it thicker. Also iv not had any reply back to my emails.UPDATE 4:I have cut off and pulled back the braiding on the micro usb cable and can confirm the printing on the cable does say its 20awg. So the micro usb cable is as specified on the website, no issues there.Only issue now is with the Mini B premium cable which is 24awg and not 22awg. Im still in two minds about returning the cable, on one side i like the connectors of the premium cable but on the other hand i prefer 22awg over 24awg. something for me to ponder over but iv raised my review stars from 1 to 3.surprised your support is more active here on trust pilot then on emails.

title: Products are great
review: Products are great, customer service and delivery needs work. I ordered a mixer on a Friday, paid for a saturday delivery (wanted it next day) it didn't arrive, neither did it arrive on the Monday. Spoke to them who told me that I missed the delivery cut off point on the Friday - my fault I accept that, I told them that I'd gotten an email to say that the mixer would be delivered on Tuesday - Because i'd emailed them to chase up the order on Monday before phoning, however I was told over the phone that wouldn't happen as the system was scheduling the delivery for the following Saturday. The less than enthusiastic employee then said he'd schedule it for next day delivery meaning it would arrive on Wednesday. No offer of a refund for the £10 delivery i'd paid when in actual fact they offer free next day delivery. I then ordered a case and dustcover, expecting next day delivery (as advertised) it arrived two days later.

title: I had received previously good service…
review: I had received previously good service from BOP so I’m a bit miffed I now have to give this feedback. After a 6month old Denon Prime4+ need a small button repair ( vinyl mode button) I was left without my controller whilst they assessed the damage. Long story short neither Bop DJ or In music would fix it.. literally a switch under a button. And my prime had been in a flight case from the second. Had owned it yet came back with loads more damage than it went in with. So let’s say I’m pretty pissed off. A 2k plus controller that now sits completely useless and I had to replace it with a brand new one. Took ages to post it back when they said they couldn’t/wouldn’t fix it. Thanks. I’ll shop elsewhere now after spending nearly 10 grand with Bop…

It was definitely this headset that wasnt working properly.I contacted the headset store to send it back. They said they wouldn't pay for the return postage. We sent it back at our cost. When they got it back they said that it 'just needed some settings changing and the firmware updating'. I asked for a refund and they refused as it had just gone past the 14 day return window, so they sent it right back. They stated they adjusted some settings so that it would work with our current phones, and they said not to change the settings. Upon receiving it back we tried it again. The headset still crackled and its not usable even at the setting they left it on. I contacted them again and they again said that there is nothing wrong with it. Its easy to refuse to refund for faulty stock if they are the judge that it's working. The only reason it went past the 14 day window is because we were trying to get it working, obviously we should have just sent it straight back for a refund (minus their 20% restocking fee) as soon as we got it and it didn't seem to work.I am sure that company is ok when everything goes well and the product is working, but when something is not working they refuse to take any responsibility and just quote their policy, even when it's clear something isn't working. They refused to be reasonable at any point. Their idea of reasonable is offering to sell us a more expensive headset, only then would they allow the none-working one to be returned.If you are confident that the product you are buying will work (which you cant be when buying from a distance), and you are happy with a 20% restocking fee within 14 days if you are not happy with the item, and you are happy that if it breaks then they will refuse to refund you, then use the company.If you don't want that risk, go somewhere where they have a decent returns policy.Reading the reviews, most of the good reviews seem to be from customers where the order has gone well.A lot of the negative ones, customers are complaining about their service. title: Pre-sales on line is fine, but after sales and delivery poor.
review: The on-line website was fine and I found the washing machine I was looking for without any problem.  The price was great with over £100 savings.  Delivery was promised for Friday,  Then the problems started.  Peter Tyson outsource their deliveries and  I received an email from BJS that it would be delivered on Friday, so I arranged for someone to be there to help me with the installation. Imagine my dismay when I received a message to say that due to a system error it was not loaded and would not be delivered and offering delivery the following day, which was not convenient.  I phoned the logistics company and agreed a Tuesday delivery so I could arrange for assistance with the installation.  The dates and time was confirmed by email.  Then on Monday afternoon I received another email stating delivery was Wednesday!  I phoned them again, spoke to a very helpful customer services advisor who said that should not have happened, contacted the depot and had the delivery reinstated.  This was confirmed by email for an early delivery between 07.00-10.00, so I set my alarm for 06.00 and whist drinking coffee checked the tracker and engaged with the chatbot who advised it was scheduled for Wednesday…. Aaarrgggh.  Fortunately just before I could phone customer services when they opened at 09.00, I got a call from the driver to say they would be arriving in 20 minutes.  What a relief following a period of angst.Then to top it all, there was no instruction manual in the drum, or tool to remove the transit bars, so I phoned Peter Tyson sales to be told that the manual was only available online and I  could by the tool from a diy shop.  Not helpful.  I also gave details of the delivery problems and he said he would get someone from customer services to call me….. I am still waiting almost 3 days later.  On a positive note, I contacted Miele who confirmed that the manual should have been in the drum and the tool is attached to the machine for delivery.In fairness I should also mention that the humidifier I ordered arrived on time delivered by DPD.

title: Very poor network signal
review: Moved to iD Mobile in September and was very disappointed with the quality and consistency of signal, especially as both iD & 3 (their carrier) say I should get excellent 4G coverage in and outdoor. I live in a rural location and so coverage can be patchy, although we have moved quite close to a mask location, but I still have to rely on wifi calling in the house and calls outside are very difficult, in contrast with my wife who is with Vodafone and gets serviceable signal outdoors.  I have been abroad and got perfect signal the whole time, so it's not a SIM fault, but when I returned to the UK, the signal disappeared (not even that strong in London!) .  I also put a 2nd SIM (Lebara on Vodafone) in my phone for a week to test how iD performed against it and there was not one time when the signal from iD was better that the Lebara signal.  Sadly I took a contract so I am stuck with this for the next 2 years but will try to save up and buy my way out of the contract as the service is so poor. Avoid iD/3.Further to reply from iD below:JimThanks for the template reply you give to all reviews of this nature.If you had actually read it it you would see that I had done what you recommend before I even took out the contract. The trouble is that the information it gives is misleading.
